original_test_intent: Check the chassis identification indicator in its normal/off state and while the BMC identification command requests blinking, retaining undefined amber states.
original_method: A qualified operator identifies the exact ID button/LED, records normal power-state behavior, invokes a pinned owner-approved identify control once, measures blink behavior, clears the identify request and verifies return to normal.
manual_activity: An on-site operator records the exact ID indicator in normal state, during the approved BMC identify request and after explicit clear, preserving power state and direct color/cadence evidence.
required_inputs: Physical ID button/LED location, color capability and BMC control mapping
Decision whether the Green Solid section actually requires solid green or documents OFF normal behavior
Exact supported BMC identify command/API, target, privilege, duration and clear action
Expected Green Blink frequency/duty, assertion latency and timeout
Normal-state definition across AC-off, standby, host-off and host-on if applicable
Amber Solid/Blink definitions or revision-scoped N/A disposition
Independent BMC access and identify-state recovery
safety_requirements: Do not invent an ipmitool, Redfish or vendor identify command
Verify target system identity before changing its locate state
Use bounded identify duration where supported and explicitly clear the request
Do not treat a BMC control bit as proof that the physical LED emitted the expected color/cadence
Do not create amber behavior with unsupported fault stimuli
Stop on wrong-system indication, stuck locate state, BMC loss, power or thermal anomaly; never auto-retry
agent_execution_scope: Verify source, target identity and approved control contract
Collect read-only BMC inventory and identify state before/after
Prepare command audit and synchronize operator video to the request/clear timestamps
Confirm logical state restoration without claiming visual acceptance
Perform no unapproved command, physical observation, power action, retry or verdict
engineer_actions: Resolve Green Solid versus OFF semantics and define normal states
Approve exact identify request/clear interface and cadence/timing
Define or mark N/A amber modes
Review visual/control evidence and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly states visual acceptance is not remotely observable, but does not preserve the logical identify control as a separately approved stimulus.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the supported bounded identify interface only after approval; direct operator video remains the acceptance evidence and an explicit clear is mandatory.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Normal/off, BMC-command blink, both undefined amber states and 15/5-minute estimates remain.

modernized_recommendation.status: MANUAL ID-INDICATOR REVIEW PENDING NORMAL-STATE POLARITY DECISION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Record contextual and close video before, during and after a bounded identify request; align frames with audited control-state transitions and verify explicit clear.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds target identity, supported interface, cadence/timing, bounded duration and restoration while preserving the source conflict.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: BMC logical state corroborates but cannot prove emitted light; amber states and the Green Solid/OFF discrepancy remain unresolved.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Locate controls may be global, persistent or shared between front/rear indicators. Without exact physical mapping and a post-clear observation, a command can appear successful while the wrong LED blinks or the locate state remains latched.

project_override_considerations: If the hardware's normal ID indicator is intentionally off and green is only used for blink, engineering should correct the review-layer state matrix while preserving the Master wording and decision trail.
expected_evidence: Approved ID indicator map, normal-state and color/cadence matrix
Exact supported identify request/clear audit with target, duration, timestamps and exit/API status
Contextual and close video before/during/after identify
Read-only BMC state and explicit restored normal state
Amber disposition, no-wrong-target/no-auto-retry audit, hashes and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source places 'Off when power off and normal' beneath Green Solid while Criteria names Green Solid. It is unclear whether solid green is required in another state or whether the heading is copied/mislabeled.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The normal and identify-blink observations are technically reviewable after an approved command. Final state coverage waits for the polarity decision without stopping this static review.

engineering_decision_pending: Resolve Functionality row 1913 Wistron-HW-00463-V002: whether the Green Solid heading requires a solid-green state or is a mislabeled normal-OFF requirement; define normal behavior by power state, exact identify request/clear interface, green cadence/timing and amber disposition while preserving Master.
review_improvement: Separates logical identify control from optical acceptance, exposes the normal-state polarity conflict, and requires bounded request plus verified clear.
independent_technical_reasoning: A successful BMC identify request proves only that a control path accepted the command. The physical locate function may address a different chassis indicator, use another color, or remain latched after the session. Direct before/during/after evidence and exact target mapping are therefore necessary, while the source's Green Solid/OFF mismatch prevents an authoritative normal-state verdict.
